name: BAE Systems plc
operational_role: Britain's largest defense contractor; tier-one global partner producing approximately 15% of the value of every F-35 Lightning II aircraft, including the rear fuselage, electronic warfare suite, and fuel systems.
government_liaisons: United States Department of Defense (Joint Program Office)
documented_activities: Manufactures essential subcomponents for the F-35 fleet (designated 'Adir' in the Israeli Air Force), which conducted intense strategic bombardment operations across Gaza. When the UK government announced a suspension of approximately 30 arms export licenses to Israel in September 2024 due to clear risks of IHL violations, the F-35 program components were explicitly exempted from the embargo to preserve the global supply chain.
documented_consequences: Continuous unbroken supply of advanced strike aircraft components used in air campaigns resulting in mass urban casualties and structural destruction in Gaza.
